name: Abalone (Declarative)
description: Move a line of one, two or three marbles one space. A line may move sideways into empty spaces, or push a shorter opposing line forward. Eject six opposing marbles to win. This version ends after 500 moves and scores remaining marbles.
rules: Move a line of one, two or three marbles one space. A line may move sideways into empty spaces, or push a shorter opposing line forward. Eject six opposing marbles to win. This version ends after 500 moves and scores remaining marbles.
ui_instructions: Select your marble or stones, then choose a highlighted legal destination. Catan offers its current legal build or action choices. All game rules and move validation are authoritative on the server.

tutorial.text: Move a line of one, two or three marbles one space. A line may move sideways into empty spaces, or push a shorter opposing line forward. Eject six opposing marbles to win. This version ends after 500 moves and scores remaining marbles.
tutorial.html:
Abalone

Move a line of one, two or three marbles one space. A line may move sideways into empty spaces, or push a shorter opposing line forward. Eject six opposing marbles to win. This version ends after 500 moves and scores remaining marbles.
